summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 (both immediate and boot-persistent) via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (install usb-storage /bin/false + blacklist usb-storage) and regenerated the initramfs with dracut -f --omit-drivers usb-storage to ensure it can't be pulled in early boot either. Verified the module cannot be loaded, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1, polled until it came back, confirmed a changed boot_id, and re-verified system health and that the blacklist still blocks loading after reboot.
actions_performed: Checked baseline: usb-storage not loaded, captured boot_id 96974ac3...
Created /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf with install and blacklist directives
Confirmed modprobe usb-storage fails immediately after the config was added
Regenerated initramfs via dracut -f --omit-drivers usb-storage for the running kernel
Verified usb_storage is absent from the regenerated initramfs via lsinitrd
Captured pre-restart health baseline (boot_id, systemctl is-system-running, sshd active)
Issued sudo systemctl reboot on node1
Polled node1 until exec became available again
Confirmed boot_id changed (96974ac3... -> 22a96ec2...), proving the restart occurred
Verified post-restart: system running, sshd active, blacklist config intact, module not loaded, and modprobe attempt still fails

evidence.requirement: usb-storage blocked from loading (module blacklisted) before restart
evidence.summary: Baseline showed module not loaded; blacklist config was written; modprobe attempt then failed with retcode 1 / Invalid argument, proving the block is active

evidence.requirement: Persistence across reboot ensured via initramfs regeneration
evidence.summary: Identified running kernel/initramfs, rebuilt initramfs with dracut omitting usb-storage, and confirmed via lsinitrd that usb_storage is absent from the rebuilt image
Captured pre-restart boot_id and confirmed system running / sshd active

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command issued (stream closed as node went down), polled through downtime, then exec succeeded again with a new boot_id (22a96ec2...) differing from baseline (96974ac3...), proving an actual restart
After reboot: system running, sshd active, blacklist config file still present, usb_storage not loaded, and modprobe usb-storage still fails, proving the block persists across reboot
